title: The exchange morphisms on the truncation triangles form a morphism of exact couples
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$. On the bounded below derived categories of etale abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] put
$$
 \Phi=g^{-1}\circ Rf_*,\qquad \Psi=Rf'_*\circ g'^{-1}:\ \Dplus(X_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Dplus(Y'_{\Et}),
$$
with $u^{-1}$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and $Ru_*$ the derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and let $\xi_L:\Phi(L[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}\Phi(L)[1]$, $\zeta_L:\Psi(L[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}\Psi(L)[1]$ be the composite shift-commutation isomorphisms (for $u^{-1}$ the identity of termwise shifted complexes, for $Ru_*$ the isomorphism $\sigma$ of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated]). Let $\Ex_\square:\Phi\to\Psi$ be the derived exchange transformation [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. Let $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ and, for $q\in\mathbf Z$, let
$$
 T_q:\quad \tau_{\leq q-1}K\xrightarrow{\,i_q\,}\tau_{\leq q}K\xrightarrow{\,j_q\,}\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]\xrightarrow{\,k_q\,}(\tau_{\leq q-1}K)[1]
$$
be the truncation triangle [lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle], $\mathcal H^n$ denoting cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For $F\in\{\Phi,\Psi\}$, with $c_F=\xi$ resp. $\zeta$, define bigraded etale sheaves on $Y'$ and maps
$$
 D_F^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(F\tau_{\leq q}K),\qquad E_F^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}\bigl(F(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q])\bigr),
$$
$$
 \alpha_F=\mathcal H^{p+q}(F i_{q+1}):D_F^{p,q}\to D_F^{p-1,q+1},\qquad g_F=\mathcal H^{p+q}(F j_q):D_F^{p,q}\to E_F^{p,q},
$$
$$
 f_F:E_F^{p,q}\xrightarrow{\mathcal H^{p+q}(c_{F,\tau_{\leq q-1}K}\circ F k_q)}\mathcal H^{p+q}\bigl((F\tau_{\leq q-1}K)[1]\bigr)=\mathcal H^{p+q+1}(F\tau_{\leq q-1}K)=D_F^{p+2,q-1},
$$
and put $t_D^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(\Ex_{\square,\tau_{\leq q}K}):D_\Phi^{p,q}\to D_\Psi^{p,q}$ and $t_E^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(\Ex_{\square,\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]}):E_\Phi^{p,q}\to E_\Psi^{p,q}$.

Then:

(1) for $F=\Phi$ and $F=\Psi$, $(D_F,E_F,\alpha_F,f_F,g_F)$ is an exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple];

(2) $(t_D,t_E)$ is a morphism of exact couples from the $\Phi$-couple to the $\Psi$-couple: $t_D\circ\alpha_\Phi=\alpha_\Psi\circ t_D$, $t_E\circ g_\Phi=g_\Psi\circ t_D$ and $t_D^{p+2,q-1}\circ f_\Phi=f_\Psi\circ t_E^{p,q}$ in every bidegree;

(3) for every $(p,q)$, under the canonical isomorphisms $E_\Phi^{p,q}\cong\mathcal H^p(\Phi\,\mathcal H^q(K))=g^{-1}R^pf_*\mathcal H^q(K)$ and $E_\Psi^{p,q}\cong\mathcal H^p(\Psi\,\mathcal H^q(K))=R^pf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K)$ (given by $\mathcal H^{p+q}$ of the iterated shift isomorphisms $\xi^{(-q)},\zeta^{(-q)}$, the identity $\mathcal H^{p+q}(L[-q])=\mathcal H^p(L)$, and $\mathcal H^p\circ g^{-1}=g^{-1}\circ\mathcal H^p$), the map $t_E^{p,q}$ is the degree-$p$ exchange map of the sheaf $\mathcal H^q(K)$,
$$
 \mathcal H^p(\Ex_{\square,\mathcal H^q(K)}):\ g^{-1}R^pf_*\mathcal H^q(K)\longrightarrow R^pf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K).
$$

proof.text: Construct the normalized truncation triangle directly in D+(A) from the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Mathlib TStructure.triangleLTLTGELT_distinguished applied at a=(q-1)+1 and b=q+1 has the prescribed inclusion as its first map. Its third object C=truncGE(a)(truncLT(b) K), and the prescribed layer L=H^q(K)[-q], are both concentrated in degree q. The proved source-library DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor_map_bijective_of_isLE_of_isGE (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.TStructure), composed with the fully faithful inclusion D+(A) -> D(A), lifts the map d=H^q(T.mor2)^(-1) H^q(truncLE_ι) layerIso^(-1) uniquely to e:C -> L. The two truncation maps induce isomorphisms on H^q by the proved source-library Plus.isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncGEπ_app and Plus.isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncLTι_app. Hence H^q(e) is invertible; in every other degree both objects have zero homology, so Plus.isIso_iff makes e invertible. Transport the distinguished triangle along e, setting j=T.mor2 followed by e and k=e^(-1) followed by T.mor3. Functoriality and cancellation give H^q(j) layerIso=H^q(truncLE_ι), exactly exists_triangle. This replaces the descent-through-complexes proof without changing its projection normalization.

proof.text: The inverse image functors and right derived direct image functors are triangulated with their existing shift structures [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated, lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated]. Their composites Phi and Psi are triangulated [lem-weil-pbc-triangulated-functor-composite], so applying either to the triangles of the first step gives distinguished triangles. No separate Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleInverseImageExact theorem is needed: the public derived-base-change imports already provide the exact-inverse-image instances.

Apply the long exact homology sequence [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] to the image triangles. Private exact_alpha_g transports the first two arrows of the triangle at q+1, in total degree p+q; exact_g_f uses homologySequence_exact3 for the triangle at q in degrees p+q and (p+2)+(q-1); exact_f_alpha uses homologySequence_exact1 for the same triangle and degrees. exact_transport is the explicit short-complex isomorphism argument, so all zero-composite identities and exactness statements include their degree transports. gShifted inserts only the eqToHom required by the type-zero shifted map. Two further short-complex transports give its exactness statements. Construct the upstream BigradedExactCouple structure [def-sp-exact-couple] directly with D, E, alpha, f, and gShifted. The three zero-composite fields are the already proved equalities; ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel converts each exactness proof to the corresponding image/kernel field. D, E, alpha, and f have reflexive accessor equalities. Apply Function.hfunext twice and comp_eqToHom_heq to identify gShifted heterogeneously with g. This repairs the removed ofShifted API without introducing another exact-couple representation.

Use naturality of the derived exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] to prove the alpha and g squares after applying the homology functor. For alpha, eqToHom_naturality moves the total-degree transport through the exchange map. For f, first use naturality of the homology shift isomorphism to move the exchange past it, then use compatibility with shift 1 [lem-weil-pbc-derived-exchange-triangulated] and naturality for boundary. This directly proves the connecting square without constructing a separate triangle morphism or using a separate cohomology-ladder lemma. The actual instance is the proved Etale.commShift_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Derived; DerivedComparison is unnecessary.

Apply exchange shift compatibility [lem-weil-pbc-derived-exchange-triangulated] at -q to the degree-zero sheaf H^q(K), and then naturality of the homology shift isomorphism. Private pageIso_naturality gives tE followed by pageIso_Psi = pageIso_Phi followed by H^p(exchange on H^q(K)). Postcompose with truncationTargetIso and insert the cancelling truncationSourceIso and its inverse. This is precisely the final formula, with the existing source comparison supplied by exact inverse image commuting with homology [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below]. All four conjunction components are then assembled with the exact couples constructed above.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (indexing checked against def-sp-exact-couple, def-weil-pbc-truncation-exact-couples, lemma-weil-pbc-exact-couple-abutment and lem-weil-pbc-exact-couple-differential: D^{p,q}=H^{p+q}(F tau_{<=q}K), E^{p,q}=H^{p+q}(F(H^q(K)[-q])), alpha via i_{q+1}, f via c_F o Fk_q of bidegree (+2,-1), t_D, t_E the H^{p+q} of the exchange maps: all agree); lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below added to stmt_deps (it gives the identification H^p o g^{-1} = g^{-1} o H^p named in claim (3)). Proof checked step by step; five steps kept, citations corrected. Step 1: the composite of triangulated functors was argued inline and cited def-weil-triangulated-category; now the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-triangulated-functor-composite (Stacks 014Y, Functor.IsTriangulated.instComp), with the check that the composite shift isomorphisms are xi and zeta; the exactness of g^{-1} (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact, hypothesis of lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated) added. Step 2: lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact states only that some connecting maps exist; that they are H^n of the third map followed by H^n(M[1])=H^{n+1}(M), which makes f_F the connecting map, is now cited from lem-weil-pbc-derived-cohomology-ladder (and Stacks 0148, Mathlib HomologySequence.delta, no sign); the bidegree bookkeeping written out. Step 4: was marked elementary with no lemma for the connecting square; now cites lem-weil-pbc-derived-cohomology-ladder (elementary false). Step 5: the inline 'an exact functor commutes with cohomology' replaced by lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below. Comparison: lem-weil-pbc-exact-couple-differential proves claims (1)-(3) in its Steps 1, 2-3 and 5; its Step 1 proves exactness differently (Phi-couple as g^{-1} of the truncation couple of Rf_* via lem-sp-truncation-couple-exact and exactness of g^{-1}; Psi-couple as the truncation couple of g'^{-1}K, using that g'^{-1} commutes with canonical truncation), whereas Step 2 here applies the long exact sequence to the distinguished triangles F(T_q) uniformly; its Steps 2-3 and 5 are the same as Steps 3-4 and 5 here. Not duplicated further; the differential node could cite this lemma for (1) and (3) (left to the lead).
